decision_rationale: The record presents a new genome-scale language model for SARS-CoV-2 and reports training/generation on nucleotide and codon sequences. The provided evidence does not show a substantive natural-language text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "input to GenSLM are nucleotide sequences, encoded at the codon level"; "genome-scale language models"; "generate new SARS-CoV-2 sequences"; "learned a semantic embedding of individual codons"; natural text is mentioned only for comparison, not as model input/output in this paper's candidate model; no substantive text-bio bridge is described; natural language is absent in the candidate model's core inputs/outputs; "sentence" is used only for genome segmentation, not natural-language text; no text descriptions, prompts, captions, or reports are used as model inputs; evidence_for_generative_model: not_assessed
